CFML Language Reference: Functions

ReplaceList

Takes two comma-delimited lists and replaces every occurrence of each item in the first list with the corresponding item in the second. The search is case-sensitive.

Category

String functions

Syntax

ReplaceList(string, list1, list2)

Parameters

string
The string to work on.
list1
Comma-delimited list of strings to search for.
list2
Comma-delimited list of replacements. If it is shorter than list1, the extra items of list1 are replaced with an empty string.

Returns

The string with all the replacements made.

Usage

The replacements are made one list item at a time, each over the whole string, so a later item can change text produced by an earlier one: ReplaceList("abc", "a,b", "b,c") returns "ccc", not "bcc". Order your lists accordingly.

Because the lists are comma-delimited, you cannot search for a comma with ReplaceList; use Replace.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Shorthand = "Pls call me b4 lunch, thx, cu l8r">
<CFSET Short = "Pls,b4,thx,cu,l8r">
<CFSET Long = "Please,before,thanks,see you,later">
<CFOUTPUT>
<P><B>Before:</B> #Shorthand#</P>
<P><B>After:</B> #ReplaceList(Shorthand, Short, Long)#</P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

Replace, ReplaceNoCase, REReplace, ListChangeDelims
